orders_paid_consistent.name: orders_paid_consistent
orders_paid_consistent.value: ("orders"."status" <> 'PAID') or ("orders"."paid_at" is not null and "orders"."invoice_number" is not null)

guest_responses_message_length.name: guest_responses_message_length
guest_responses_message_length.value: "guest_responses"."message" is null or char_length("guest_responses"."message") between 1 and 500
